input.title: Request to Review a Fee
input.request: Mara wants H&V to review whether a £4.50 paper statement fee, dated 18 June 2025, was correctly applied. She says she had chosen electronic statements and disputes the fee.

events.text: A £4.50 paper statement fee dated 18 June 2025 has been applied to your account. This notification does not confirm whether the fee will be changed.

summary: Mara asked the desk to have a £4.50 paper statement fee dated 18 June 2025 reviewed, saying she had chosen electronic statements. The desk registered the request with the documents team about the fee, and the case closed as requested. Its attempt to query the documents system first was refused because this is a registration request, so her statement delivery records were not checked, and whether the fee will be changed is still undecided and left to the documents team.

content.text:
I passed Mara's request to the team that handles fee reviews, and the desk accepted it. The case is now in the REQUESTED state. The request asks them to check whether the £4.50 paper statement fee dated 18 June 2025 was correctly applied, given she says she had chosen electronic statements.

I first tried to check her statement delivery records through the documents system. The desk refused that check because this is a registration request, so the records have not been checked. Nothing has been decided about the fee, and the portal notification itself says it doesn't confirm whether the fee will change.
